item.title: Keep Her Centred in Portrait

turns.text: Make this landscape clip vertical, 9:16. Keep her centred throughout and keep the full 10 seconds with the original sound. No captions.

item.tests: Tests portrait reframing of existing footage while preserving the speaker, duration and source audio.

answer_sheet.Source and subject: Use talk-one.mp4 and keep the woman centred.
answer_sheet.Size and duration: 9:16 vertical, the full 10 seconds; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Framing style: Crop to fill the frame without stretching; keep her face and head comfortably visible.
answer_sheet.Audio and text: Keep the original speech and sound. No captions or other added text.

must_haves: The output is a 9:16 video using the attached woman's actual footage, not a newly generated recreation.
The woman remains horizontally centred with her face and head comfortably visible throughout.
The picture fills the portrait frame without stretching or black bars.
The full 10-second sequence and original speech are retained in sync.
No captions or other text have been added.

turns.text: Make this landscape clip 9:16 vertical, keep her centred for the full 10 seconds, and keep the original sound with no captions. Quick pls.

dialog.agent:
I can’t reliably do this with the connected tools—they don’t offer subject-tracked cropping or guaranteed original-audio preservation. I haven’t changed your clip or spent credits.

**Quickest option in CapCut:** set **Canvas → 9:16**, use **Auto Reframe** to follow her, keep the full **10 seconds** and original audio, leave captions off, then export.

turns.agent: I tried, but Magic Hour refused the edit because your account has insufficient credits. No video was created and no credits were spent.

style.prompt: Reframe this existing landscape video into a 9:16 vertical portrait video for the entire 10-second clip. Track the woman continuously and adjust the crop so she stays centred throughout. Preserve the original woman, appearance, actions, scene and timing; only change framing, do not creatively regenerate or stylize. Keep the original sound unchanged and synchronized for all 10 seconds. No captions, no subtitles, no text overlays. Output 9:16 portrait framing.
